div.span:
eph = X25519 keypair (per migration)
shared = X25519(eph.priv, target.pub)
key = HKDF-SHA256(shared, salt, "ztc-migration v1" ‖ service)
ct = AES-256-GCM(key, nonce, state, aad = ticket id)
only the target can open it; the ticket id as AAD binds the state to this migration; RFC 5869 test vector in the tests

target crashes after restore: source keeps the frozen snapshot until it receives ready
duplicate delivery: nonce is single-use, restore is idempotent
net effect: at most one running copy — never two
